public_rationale: PwC's survey of 4,454 CEOs found that 56% reported no significant financial benefit from AI to date; fieldwork ended November 10, 2025, and results were published January 19, 2026. [e1] This supports the majority claim when “return on investment” means significant financial benefit. [e1] The separate four-country study surveyed almost 6,000 CEOs, CFOs and other executives, rather than CEOs alone. [e2] Its finding that over 80% of firms reported no employment or productivity impact over the preceding three years does not establish financial returns. [e2]
limitations: The evidence does not establish formally calculated net returns on AI investment; PwC reports self-reported financial benefits. [e1, e2]
The four-country study does not establish financial returns specifically among CEOs, and the reviewed version was available March 16, 2026, after the February 26 claim. [e2]
